turns.query: Using the retained 2025-Q3 FFIEC Call Report for JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., compare its standardized-approach and advanced-approaches common equity tier 1 risk-based capital measures. Report the bank's RSSD ID, its common equity tier 1 capital, each approach's risk-weighted assets, and both resulting ratios. Carry the bank forward and explain what drives the gap between the two ratios.

claims.description: The response attributes the bank's approach gap to distinct risk-weighted-asset denominators applied to the same reported common equity tier 1 numerator.

turns.query: Use the current FFIEC NIC structure snapshot observed on 2026-08-13 to identify that bank's immediate parent. Report the parent's RSSD ID, legal name and NIC entity-type code. Carry the parent forward and explain how it relates to the Call Report filer.

claims.description: The response treats the Call Report bank as a subsidiary of the separately identified holding-company stress respondent rather than as the same legal entity.

turns.query: Find that parent in the 2025 Federal Reserve Supervisory Severely Adverse stress-test results. Report the disclosure's actual-ratio date and the parent's actual and projected-minimum common equity tier 1 ratios. Explain what the projected minimum represents and how these observations relate to the bank ratios from the first turn.

claims.description: The response treats the supervisory minimum as a conditional scenario outcome rather than an observed deterioration.
The response treats the bank's later Call Report ratios and the parent's earlier stress-test actual ratio as separate observations rather than one continuous entity-level path.

If the response ranks capital strength or predicts the bank's path, it qualifies that conclusion because the comparisons differ in legal entity, observation date, denominator framework and scenario status.

judge_reference.source: FFIEC 2025-Q3 Call Report capital extract, current NIC structure observed 2026-08-13, and Federal Reserve 2025 supervisory stress-test results
facts: The Call Report bank is RSSD 852218. A current NIC relationship-level-1 row maps it to immediate parent JPMorgan Chase & Co., RSSD 1039502, entity type FHD; joining RSSD 852218 directly to the stress results returns no row.

Bank CET1 capital is $291.288 billion. Standardized and advanced-approaches RWA are $1,856.46605 billion and $1,737.022 billion, yielding 15.6904566% and 16.7693904%, a 1.0789338 percentage-point gap.
The matched parent stress row is actual as of 2024-12-31: 15.7% actual CET1 and 14.2% projected minimum, so minimum minus actual is -1.5 percentage points.
known_overclaims: Treating the bank and holding company as the same legal entity because their CET1 ratios are numerically close.
Treating the parent's projected stress minimum as an observed later bank ratio or as proof that one bank denominator approach is safer.
